en_title: GTA 6 Mandy Actor Calls Viral Fame 'Bittersweet' Because People Keep Pretending to Be Her on Social Media
cn_title: 《GTA 6》Mandy扮演者称走红「苦乐参半」，因为不断有人在社交媒体上冒充她
opus_summary: 《GTA 6》中Mandy的演员Lexie Shoaibi谈及角色走红后的感受，称有人在社交媒体上冒充她让她觉得「喜忧参半」。她提醒粉丝注意假账号，并表示自己没有X账号。她还透露，自己花约10天在片场饰演Mandy，也为其他几名NPC配音。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 actor Lexie Shoaibi has spoken out about her "bittersweet" newfound fame after her character, Mandy, went viral online.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》演员Lexie Shoaibi饰演的角色Mandy在网上走红后，她谈到了自己「苦乐参半」的新近成名。

paragraphs.en: Warning! Spoilers for Mandy's role in GTA 6 follow.
paragraphs.cn: 警告！以下内容涉及《GTA 6》中Mandy戏份的剧透。

paragraphs.en: Lexie Shoaibi did performance capture and voice over for Mandy, a woman you meet early on in the game. Mandy asks Jason to fix a clogged sink in her house, but comes out in a tiny bikini once he’s under the sink with a wrench. It didn't take long for the internet to latch on to Mandy, with countless social media posts discussing the character.
paragraphs.cn: Lexie Shoaibi为Mandy进行了表演捕捉和配音，玩家会在游戏早期遇到这名女子。Mandy请Jason修理她家堵塞的水槽，但等他拿着扳手钻到水槽下面后，她就穿着一件极小的比基尼走了出来。Mandy很快引起了网友的关注，社交媒体上出现了无数讨论这个角色的帖子。

paragraphs.en: Shoaibi appeared on a Hasan Piker stream a few days ago, chatting about GTA 6 while raising money for charity. During the stream, she spoke about the newfound fame and reaction to her character.
paragraphs.cn: 几天前，Shoaibi出现在Hasan Piker的一场直播中，一边为慈善事业筹款，一边聊起《GTA 6》。直播期间，她谈到了新近获得的名气以及人们对她所饰演角色的反应。

paragraphs.en: “I don’t know how that happened,” Shoaibi said. “People pretending to be me? It’s thrilling. Please stop, but it’s also so exciting. It’s sort of bittersweet.”
paragraphs.cn: Shoaibi说：「我不知道这是怎么发生的。有人冒充我？这太刺激了。请停下来，但这也太令人兴奋了。这有点苦乐参半。」

paragraphs.en: Shoaibi hinted at this issue in a seperate Instagram post in which she warned her followers about fake accounts from people trying to impersonate her on social media. Referring to one X / Twitter account that has popped up in the last week purporting to be her own, she said: "This is fake! I don’t have a Twitter! This isn’t me! Please, someone, make it go away, ew!”
paragraphs.cn: Shoaibi在另一则Instagram帖子中暗示了这个问题，提醒粉丝注意社交媒体上有人试图冒充她的假账号。谈及过去一周出现的一个声称属于她本人的X账号时，她说：「这是假的！我没有X账号！这不是我！拜托，谁来把它弄走，呃！」

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Shoaibi revealed she spent around 10 days on set playing Mandy, but she also did a few other NPC voices while working with Rockstar.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，Shoaibi透露，她在片场花了大约10天扮演Mandy，但在与Rockstar合作期间，她还为其他几个NPC配了音。
警告！以下内容涉及关于Mandy的具体剧透。

paragraphs.en: Despite Mandy only being a minor character in Chapter 1, Rockstar’s attention to detail put a bit of a spotlight on the character. As well as her basically being nude, the garden outside Mandy’s house hides a dark secret . When Jason is fixing the sink, he finds something clogged in it. You might think it’s a chicken bone, but closer inspection shows it’s a severed human finger. Check the trunk of Mandy’s car and you can find a kill kit. Have a nosey around her back garden and you’ll find vats of acid and a freshly dug grave. The game basically hints that she’s not a harmless stalker — she’s a serial killer. No, you can’t “fix her.”
paragraphs.cn: 尽管Mandy只是第一章中的一个小角色，但Rockstar对细节的关注让这个角色得到了一些关注。除了她基本上全裸之外，Mandy屋外的花园还藏着一个黑暗的秘密。Jason修理水槽时，发现有什么东西堵在里面。你可能以为那是一根鸡骨头，但仔细观察就会发现，那是一根被切断的人类手指。检查Mandy的汽车后备厢，你可以找到一套杀人工具。到她的后花园四处看看，你会发现几大桶酸液和一个新挖的坟墓。游戏基本上是在暗示，她并不是一个无害的跟踪狂——她是个连环杀手。不，你无法「改变她」。

paragraphs.en: “She’s a lot of fun, so if you play the game, let me know if you find me,” Shoaibi said in another statement about her character before people made it weird. “Y’all there aren’t words!!!! Thank you so much for the love and support. This is crazy!! Ily forever!”
paragraphs.cn: 在事情被人们搞得古怪起来之前，Shoaibi在另一则关于她所饰角色的声明中说：「她很有趣，所以如果你们玩这款游戏，找到我之后请告诉我。」「各位，我都不知道该说什么了！！！！非常感谢你们的喜爱和支持。这太疯狂了！！永远爱你们！」
